title: Making diversity count: diversifying the chemical sciences curriculum by highlighting overlooked scientists
content: The work of minoritized scientists has often not been highlighted adequately in the chemical sciences curricula, at all stages of the education journey. Sporadic efforts have been made previously to address this, by featuring the contributions of currently overlooked scientists from diverse backgrounds. Herein, we propose a wider programme-level approach where we introduce a range of educational resources highlighting currently overlooked scientists to promote additional role models and diversify chemical sciences curricula. A website (www.iccs-megs.co.uk) containing these resources is now freely accessible globally to be adopted by disciplines aligned to and including the chemical sciences. Our aim is to create a global platform for anyone interested in curriculum diversification and promotion of currently underrepresented groups in the chemical sciences.
